featured_reviews.name: Jabir Najmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Beyond Basics Collection. I purchased an electronic puppy toy from this shop on March 13th, and within just a few days, the toy stopped working completely.
I visited the store to report the issue, and they took the product from me around March 28th/29th, saying they would send it to the manufacturer for inspection. A few days later, I was informed that the manufacturer claimed the toy had an “electronic fault due to a fall.” This is completely inaccurate the toy was never dropped or damaged. It simply stopped working on its own.
Despite charging higher prices, the quality of their products is clearly not reliable. The way this issue was handled also felt dismissive and unfair, as the fault was incorrectly attributed to usage rather than a genuine defect.
I would strongly advise others to think twice before purchasing any electronic products from this shop. The product quality and after-sales support are both questionable.

featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
🤩🤩MINISO – Dadar West (Just 1 min walk from station)
Visited this cute little store today and it's a total heaven for girls! From fancy perfumes, soft toys, stylish handbags, cute lipsticks to amazing daily use items — everything is well-organized and aesthetic.
But the highlight? The Barbie Section!
Full of pink-colored goodies like bottles, cups, bags, and more — a dream zone for all Barbie lovers! It's truly outstanding and eye-catching.
Prices are a bit high (a Barbie bottle was around ₹800), but the variety and cuteness totally make it worth a visit.
If you love collecting cute and unique items, this place is a must-visit!🤩🤩🤩🤩

featured_reviews.name: PRERNA GAIKWAD
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Miniso today and I am a regular customer here, but this experience was extremely disappointing. After entering the store, I had to step out for a short while, leaving my friend inside. During that time, the staff started accusing me of stealing something and even mentioned that they would check the CCTV cameras.
This behavior was very unprofessional and upsetting, especially towards a loyal customer. Due to time constraints, I couldn’t go back and speak to the store manager, but this kind of treatment is unacceptable.
Today onwards I won’t be buying even a single small item out of this store

featured_reviews.name: komal sonone
featured_reviews.review_text: Decent place but could be better. The store has a fun range of cute and budget-friendly products, and you can find some good small gifts and accessories here. However, some items feel cheaply made and not very durable, and a few staff members seem uninterested or unhelpful when you ask for assistance overall it’s okay if you’re just browsing, but quality and service aren’t always consistent

featured_reviews.name: Amey Bhalekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience at the Miniso store. The products were really good, and I ended up purchasing a few items as gifts. I’d especially like to appreciate the staff member, Pooja, who was extremely helpful, kind, and pleasant to talk to. Her support made the shopping experience even better.

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya
featured_reviews.review_text: I purchased several items from your Dadar branch yesterday, including wet wipes. Upon opening, the wipes were completely dry and unusable. I would like a refund or a replacement for this defective batch.

featured_reviews.name: Krutika Pednekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Has to be one of the worst Miniso outlets in terms of customer service. The attitude of staff Ms. Aarti Patil (cashier) was horrendous.
At billing counter she damaged the product while removing the product tag and when I pointed out, she snubbed and told me "aapko gift toh nahi dena hai na toh chala lo". Arey bhai!!? After that she made faces and told me "Cash nahi hai gpay kardo".
If such is the attitude of your staff I am not visiting Miniso anymore. Also I have reached to a conclusion that Miniso now specializes in having rude, unprofessional, snobbish staff instead of cute stuff.

featured_reviews.name: Prasad Tonde
featured_reviews.review_text: Small shop just outside dadar railway station on the west side. Has almost everything a big miniso shop does. Lovely staff. Very helpful and polite

featured_reviews.name: Dr.Saranya Sasi
featured_reviews.review_text: The shop is too congested, unlike other Miniso outlets. Avoid visiting during rush hours. They have limited options available here. The staff seems inexperienced, or lacks sufficient knowledge about their products.
